about: Who rendered each region of a view is named. A region bound renders itself names the instrument by the id its fold/extension line carries; a region a capsule answered names the capsule by its digest, and the place's pin besides when the pin chose it; a region nobody answered names nobody. The asks are the ones the views already make, read back from the capsule's cache, so no page moves.
